description: Compare unified metrics across up to 10 URLs — each row is the analytics/post object (1 credit/resolved URL). Costs 1 credit/url. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

urls.description: Comma-separated post/video/reel URLs (up to 10), any mix of the same 11 platforms as Post Analytics. Example: a TikTok URL and a YouTube URL in one call.

name: analytics_compare
title: Compare Analytics
